name: Wild Beast Devotee
originalText:
### Wild Beast Devotee

- **Path Type:** Novice
- **Source:** Wild Beasts
- **Source Page:** 6
- **PDF Page:** 6

```text
Wild Beast Devotee
In the eyes of the Wild Beasts, the Horned King embodies
the violence of nature: the wolf tearing out the deer’s throat
or the mountain lion pouncing on the hiker. Wild, vicious,
and unrelenting, their god would see a world freed from all
so-called advances and restored to its primeval beauty. The
god welcomes any effort to accomplish this goal.
Devotees of the Wild Beast favor animal hides as
clothing. Most wear masks made from animal heads, with
bears and wolves being the most common. Devotees use
axes in battle, likening them to their god’s fangs.
Traditions associated with the cult include Madness,
Primal, and Transformation.
<LEVEL 1 WILD BEAST DEVOTEE
Attributes: Increase two attribute scores by 1 each.
Characteristics: Health +5, Power +1
Languages and Professions: Add hunter or tracker to your list of
professions.
Magic: You discover the Madness, Primal, or Transformation
tradition. Then, choose one benefit from the following
options:
• You discover one of the other two traditions.
• You learn one spell.
Wild, Violent Recovery: You can use an action to make an attack.
On a successful result, you heal damage equal to your healing
rate. On a failed one, you heal damage equal to half your
healing rate. In either case, you lose access to this talent until
you complete a rest. At level 8, you can use this talent twice
before losing access to it.
<LEVEL 2 WILD BEAST DEVOTEE
Characteristics: Health +5
Magic: Choose one benefit from the following options:
• You discover one tradition from the list in Level 1.
• You learn one spell.
Bloodthirsty Prayers: When you or another creature within
short range of you would attack a creature but before the dice
are rolled, you can use a triggered action to grant 1 boon on the
attacking creature’s attack roll. The creature can also choose
to gain 1 Insanity. If it gains Insanity in this way, the creature
increases the number of boons by 1 and deals an extra 1d6
damage for that attack.
<LEVEL 5 WILD BEAST DEVOTEE
Characteristics: Health +5, Power +1
Magic: You learn one spell.
Blood Frenzy: Whenever you are harmed, you go into a blood
frenzy that lasts until the end of your next turn. Until this
effect ends, you make attack rolls with 1 boon. In addition,
your melee attacks deal 1d3 extra damage.
LEVEL 8 WILD BEAST DEVOTEE
Characteristics: Health +5
Magic: You learn one spell.
Evoke the Beast Within: You can use this talent at the start of
your turn, before you do anything else. Target any number of
creatures within medium range. Each target transforms into
a wolf-hybrid. The effect lasts for 1 minute. A target makes
Perception rolls with 1 boon, gains the Shadowsight trait, and
their melee attacks deal 1d6 extra damage. When the effect
ends, the creatures choose to either take damage equal to half
their healing rate or gain 1d3 Insanity. After you use this talent,
you lose access to it until after you complete a rest.
```
